summary: NullPointerException in MethodBinding.isVarargs() during lambda expression type inference
description: JDT compiler throws NullPointerException while resolving return type bindings of nested generic lambdas where target interface contains overloaded SAM declarations.
comments: Root cause was unverified binding resolution in poly expression context. Added non-null fallback to synthetic binding.
